label: Chad McIntosh, Over 100 Arguments for the…: Some wholes cannot be made by embodied agents
locator: original presentation PDF pp.206–213: p.210, argument #86 Unities: Wholes, step 2
interpretation: Preserve both the positive some-wholes population and modal cannot-be-made restriction. This is stronger than merely not actually made by an embodied agent; no particular whole, possibility semantics or embodied-maker capability theory is supplied. Attribution is to McIntosh’s presentation only, not the unread Kronen/Menssen2013 article referenced on p211. No formal proof or premise truth is registered.
